title: Day 1: the machine, the frozen task and the baselines
text:
Machine: Intel i5-8250U, 4 cores / 8 threads, 7.6 GB RAM, no usable GPU (Intel UHD 620), so everything runs on the CPU. The task code (env.py, route_params.json and teacher.py, which env.py's route sensors use) is copied unchanged from the NEAT project and sha256-tested. 14 tests pass: determinism (same seed twice, reused and fresh env), boulder hit = crash, seed ranges, inputs come only from the observation history, numpy/torch network equivalence.

Baselines re-measured on 1,000 fresh flights (seeds 2,000,050,000+, fair boulder layout): pilot v1 72.2% [69.3-74.9], pilot v2 84.0% [81.6-86.1], the old 16-24-4 clone 84.6% [82.2-86.7]. The most common failure is coming to rest just outside the flags (6.6-6.9%), then crashes (4-5%), boulder hits (3.5%), timeouts (0.4-1.3%).

New warm start: a 2x128 network cloned from pilot v2 with DAgger (4 rounds, 789k steps, 97.7% action agreement) lands 83.5% vs the pilot's 85.9% on the same 1,000 analysis flights: the copy is as good as its source.
